preregistration.rule: Owner approves these exact bytes; their SHA-256 is recorded before the final matrix render. Changed criteria need a new version and a new acceptance run.
preregistration.calibration: Makeover rounds r6-r9 are calibration evidence, not acceptance evidence.

matrix.eastWest: Both rendered; the left-shoulder himation is never mirrored.
matrix.props: None. No held object, stamp or motif representing an ability.

idle.breath: Visible chest rise of about 1 px; pelvis and feet fixed.

animation.seams: No conspicuous snap at any loop seam.

standingHeightPx.scope: Every idle frame and facing, figure plus exterior outline, contact shadow excluded.

measured.anchor: Reference sole midpoint projects to (56,78) in every slot; no per-frame recentring.
measured.grounding: Idle soles level within 0.5 px; walk: lowest sole on the ground every frame; seated soles on the ground.
measured.clipping: Hard fail if any opaque pixel touches the cell edge.

marginPx.disposition: Report-only; any side below 6 px is shown at the owner gate.

backViewSkinThrough.method: skinclip probe over part-ID and depth passes

measured.walkResample: 8-frame walk equals 16-frame walk at matching times on all four facings: 32 of 32 pairs pixel-identical.
measured.palette: greek-retro at its approved digest; at most 48 opaque colours across the revision including outline and shadow; binary alpha; no off-palette colour.

crossFamilyReviewer: Measurement scopes, timing and resample evidence.
Robe and himation integrity: no leg, arm or skin breaking through cloth in any frame (front-facing arms resting over the cloak are allowed).
Face and beard read cleanly at 1x: no lower-face noise; beard hangs down, not forward.
Hair reads as hair, not headgear.
Seated reads as sitting: lap, two lower legs, visible feet, upright torso.
owner: Zeus identity through costume and bearing: regal, imposing, no props.
Proportions, seated posture and overall canon quality.
Motion pace at 1x and 3x timed playback.
Approve or reject the complete revision before promotion.
judged.authority: Independent review filters the submission; it does not replace owner approval.

dropped.seatedIdleHeightRatio: Replaced by the judged seated rule; with an upright seated torso the south view measures about 0.91.
